mapper.select: SELECT t0.specification_id, t0.specification_name, t0.sort, JSON_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT( 'typeId',t1.specification_type_id, 'typeName',t1.specification_type_name, 'values',t1.`values` )) AS attr_and_specs FROM ms_specification AS t0 JOIN ( SELECT t2.specification_type_id AS specification_type_id, t2.specification_type_name AS specification_type_name, t2.specification_id AS specification_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'valueId',t1.specification_value_id, 'attr',t1.attr, 'specs',t1.specs )) AS `values` FROM ms_specification_value AS t1 JOIN ms_specification_type AS t2 ON t1.specification_type_id = t2.specification_type_id GROUP BY t1.specification_type_id ) AS t1 ON t0.specification_id=t1.specification_id GROUP BY t0.specification_id ORDER BY t0.sort;

SELECT t0.specification_id, t0.specification_name, t0.sort, JSON_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT( 'typeId',t1.specification_type_id, 'typeName',t1.specification_type_name, 'values',t1.`values` )) AS attr_and_specs FROM ms_specification AS t0 JOIN ( SELECT t2.specification_type_id AS specification_type_id, t2.specification_type_name AS specification_type_name, t2.specification_id AS specification_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'valueId',t1.specification_value_id, 'attr',t1.attr, 'specs',t1.specs )) AS `values` FROM ms_specification_value AS t1 JOIN ms_specification_type AS t2 ON t1.specification_type_id = t2.specification_type_id GROUP BY t1.specification_type_id ) AS t1 ON t0.specification_id=t1.specification_id WHERE t0.specification_id = #{id} GROUP BY t0.specification_id
